title: More tools in use
statement: Members borrow the library's tools more often.
measure: Loans opened per tool in the catalog per month, counted from the loans the library records.
target: Two loans per tool per month, within a year of opening.

title: Tools back on time
statement: Members bring borrowed tools back by their due date.
measure: The share of loans returned after their due date, or still out and overdue, each month, counted from the loans the library records.
target: Under 5% of loans late each month, by the end of the first year.

title: More neighbors borrowing
statement: More people in the neighborhood are members who borrow.
measure: Active members: members who opened at least one loan in the last 90 days, counted at the end of each month.
target: 200 active members, within a year of opening.

title: Damaged tools back quickly
statement: A tool reported damaged is repaired and back in lending quickly, so members find it on the shelf.
measure: The median days from a tool's damage report to its repair, over the repairs made each month, counted from the library's damage and repair records.
target: A median under 7 days each month, by the end of the first year.
